## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4004. The issue was that notification-worker was configured to connect to `smtp-relay` using an unqualified hostname, which only resolves within the same namespace. When the platform team moved smtp-relay from the `notify` namespace to `shared-infra` on Sunday night, the DNS lookups began failing. The fix is to update the SMTP_HOST configuration to use the fully qualified domain name `smtp-relay.shared-infra.svc.cluster.local` for cross-namespace service discovery.
